notes.zh-CN: 修复使用 Gemini（Antigravity）时偶发产生大量重复消息的问题：延长活跃回放流的排空上限避免长会话被提前截断，在非活跃回合及迟到回放期间拦截多余的 session/load 回放块，并修复回合合并中的游标越界、乱序、权限/提示拆分与失败回合错配。macOS 为 universal 开发签名，未公证。Windows 安装包未签名。Android APK 为调试签名。iOS IPA 为开发签名，仅供团队已注册设备安装。
notes.en: Fixed occasional duplicate message floods when using Gemini (Antigravity): raised the active replay drain ceiling so long session histories are not cut off mid-stream, guarded idle and active turns against late session/load replay chunks, and made turn replay merging order-tolerant, split-tolerant, and turn-aligned. The universal macOS app is development-signed and unnotarized. Windows installers are unsigned. The Android APK is debug-signed. The development-signed iOS IPA installs on registered team devices.
